crossRefs.note: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul!…
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush.…
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore…
It will be, like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man…

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
translations.bsb: They went to the chief priests and elders and said, “We have bound ourselves with a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.
translations.kjv: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
translations.asv: And they came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
